title: Rigorous first-copy error bound and tighter 33-operation certificate

claims.statement: For f(u)=(u,u) and deterministic first-copy g(y)=y[0:1000], on BSC(1/10) with uniform 1000-bit U, eps(f,g)=1-(9/10)^1000 <= B, where B=1-floor(9^1000*10^100/10^1000)/10^100 is the exact reduced rational score declared here.

For the same explicit encoder f(u)=(u,u) and first-copy decoder g(y)=y[0:1000], the straight-line bsc-ops-v1 program in proof.md executes exactly W=33 operations on every 2000-bit received word, uses at most two registers and 48 addressed memory words, and satisfies W<=2^L with L=12611/2500.

experiments.purpose: Compute the exact first-copy block-error fraction, form the declared outward-rounded bound, check it is reduced and strictly improves the benchmark starter bound. Length and injectivity are established analytically in proof.md.

Run the unrolled first-copy decoder on the byte-identical reference counter, verify output correctness, and exactly check 33^2500<=2^12611 and strict improvement over L=101/20. Sample runs illustrate the straight-line proof.
